name: Treasury widget shows agent P&L
description: The Weft operations dashboard shows the agent's treasury P&L: a Revenue Earned and a Net P&L KPI card, plus a Financial Ledger listing at least one revenue sweep charge.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Weft landing page
Open the Operations link in the footer navigation
Operations dashboard shows a KPI card titled Revenue Earned with a dollar amount
Operations dashboard shows a KPI card titled Net P&L with a dollar amount
The Financial Ledger section is visible
Financial Ledger lists at least one charge naming a milestone
